content.text: The digital product economy is structurally unfair to creators in restricted markets. The tools that Western creators take for granted — [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/alternatives-gumroad-payhip-restricted-countries-honest-side-side-14|COREMERCH guide to alternatives]]-nigerian-creators-what-actually-how-works-5|Stripe Alternatives]] for payments, Gumroad for storefront and delivery, PayPal for international transfers — are either unavailable or functionally broken for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and dozens of other markets. The answer is not finding a better platform. The answer is removing the platform layer entirely. A sovereign digital commerce stack gives you a storefront you host, a payment processor that runs on blockchain rails, and an [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-15|automated]] delivery system that sends your product within 30 seconds of payment confirmation. You collect revenue directly into a wallet you control. You convert to local currency through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The platform cannot suspend you because you are not on any platform.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-15. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

The automated delivery pipeline for digital products follows a specific sequence that eliminates every manual step. A buyer visits the storefront, selects a product, and initiates payment. The checkout displays a QR code with the exact wallet address and payment amount in their chosen cryptocurrency, converted from USD at the current exchange rate via live price feeds. The buyer sends the payment from their wallet. NOWPayments monitors the blockchain and detects the incoming transaction within seconds of broadcast. When the transaction receives sufficient confirmations on-chain, NOWPayments fires a webhook to your Cloudflare Worker or Google Apps Script endpoint. The backend verifies the payment amount, confirms the transaction hash on the blockchain directly, logs the order, generates a receipt, and sends the download link to the buyer's email address.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

Pricing digital products in crypto is straightforward because NOWPayments handles the currency conversion automatically. You set your price in USD. The checkout pulls live exchange rates and displays the exact amount in whichever cryptocurrency the buyer selects. For USDT-denominated products, there is no conversion at all — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus network fees that typically amount to less than $0.10 on Tron or Solana. You receive the crypto equivalent of your USD price in the wallet you configured in your NOWPayments account. COREMERCH never touches these funds at any point — the wallet is yours from the moment of setup and remains yours unconditionally.
Who This Is Built For and Why

The product types that work with automated crypto delivery are any digital files that can be stored and delivered via download link: ebooks in PDF or EPUB format, courses packaged as ZIP archives, Notion templates exported as files or share links, font families as ZIP archives of OTF and TTF files, Lightroom or Capture One preset packs, beat files as WAV or MP3 archives, plugin installers, stock photo packs, software license keys, and any other file-based product. The delivery system in Stack 01 uses Google Drive shared links. Stack 02 uses Cloudflare R2 presigned URLs with configurable expiry times — typically 24 to 72 hours — which prevents download links from being shared indefinitely after a single purchase.
Sovereign digital commerce stacks enable creators to retain full control over their sales process.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, digital creators can start by selecting the necessary components, such as GitHub Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment verification. They can then integrate these components using backend logic tools like Cloudflare Workers, ensuring a seamless and automated sales process. With the right guidance and support, creators can quickly deploy their own sovereign digital commerce stack and start selling their products to a global audience.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, digital creators can use a sovereign digital commerce stack, which provides a comprehensive solution for automated ebook delivery after crypto payment. This approach enables creators to retain full control over their sales process, avoiding platform fees and restrictions, and ensuring that they can sell their products to a global audience.
NOWPayments charges only 0.5% on every sale, compared to Gumroad's 10% fee.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack, follow these steps: select a hosting service like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, choose a backend logic tool like Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, integrate a payment verification service like NOWPayments, set up digital storage solutions like Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, and configure SPF/DKIM/DMARC for secure email delivery.
